item: ADVERSARIAL CHECK of lane D1 (duplicate hunt: McpHub children vs direct claude mounts) — mcp-refresh-audit 2026-09-19 post-restart. Three most load-bearing claims re-verified with different instruments: (C1) config-set math 57/65 overlap; (C2) 12 live double-surfaces / 352 duplicated tools; (C3) disabledMcpServers unreliability (50 overlap names disabled, 6 still live).
notes: INSTRUMENTS (all different from D1's python json + bare Win32_Process): PowerShell 7 ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable set algebra (C:\Users\Prekzursil\AppData\Local\Temp\adv_d1_check.ps1, adv_d1_check2.ps1); tasklist + Get-CimInstance with CreationDate (a field D1 never reported); mechanical enumeration of THIS subagent session's own deferred-tool prefix surface (an independent session instance from D1's). Read-only; zero config writes; zero MCP tool calls. One ToolSearch call was needed to un-defer the harness Bash/Read/Write core tools (sandbox deferred them); the MCP failed-connect notice returned with that call was used only as passive corroboration. C1 CONFIRMED EXACTLY: direct=87 (incl McpHub http), disabled top-level=131, hub children=65 (top keys: settings only; 0 per-child enable/disable props), overlap=57, hub-only=8 and byte-identical name set (everything, insta-mcp, fb-messenger, tiktok, markitdown, meta-tool, biomni-hub, sliver), overlap-in-disabled=50, registry=92, ~/.mcp.json exists with 0 servers, mtimes config 2026-09-19 10:43 / both baks 2026-09-18 22:49. The 9 failed direct mounts (bedrock-claude, cloud-hub, openalex-alt, pubmed-tool, search-hub, tooluniverse, web-reader, web-search-prime, zread) independently re-observed in my own session-start notice. C2 CONFIRMED AS CLASS, COUNTS SESSION-VARIABLE: my session shows 44 mcp__McpHub__ prefixes and 31 direct prefixes (both match D1) but 11 shared live names, not 12 — github_cli direct did not spawn here (it is the one name disabled at BOTH scopes); duplicated definitions ~330 in my instance; per-server nit: mitmproxy is 25 tools/side, not 24 (352 should be ~353 in D1's session). Process probe: angr-mcp.exe now 4 instances (D1 saw 3 — stale within hours), created 09-19 10:13/10:58/11:12/11:36; angr python launcher PAIRS share creation minutes (95440+22104 both 10:13; 95652+110152 both 10:58) = true per-session double-mount spawn, while the 4 staggered exe waves = cross-session orphan accumulation — both feed the RAM-freeze driver but D1 conflated them into one cause. C3 REFUTED IN MECHANISM (D1's biggest overclaim): per-project disabledMcpServers for C:/Users/Prekzursil has 120 names and does NOT contain angr, claude-code-mcp, paper-search, schrodinger, searxng — the 5 live names were de-listed at project scope, so they spawn BY CONFIGURATION; the top-level 131-list entry for them is inert (11-name scope diff: angr, chrome-devtools, claude-code-mcp, cloud-hub, context7, firecrawl, paper-search, schrodinger, search-hub, searxng, tooluniverse are top-level-disabled but NOT per-project-disabled; chrome-devtools/context7 are live here, confirming per-project scope governs). github_cli disabled at both scopes = the one that did not spawn in my session. So the disable mechanism is scope-driven and deterministic as observed, not 'unreliable/flaky'; D1's step-5 UNVERIFIED item is settled with the opposite diagnosis (re-measures the 2026-07-19 root-scope-inert memory). nuclei misclassified: direct entry present, not disabled at either scope, yet session-absent — spawn-side cause, UNVERIFIED (settle via McpHub serve.err.log grep or mcp doctor). The '45 latent doubles behind an unreliable list' headline must be re-derived against per-project lists before the 45 is citable. Bottom line: the duplicate-mount defect is real and exactly quantified at config level; recommendations 1/3/4 stand, recommendation 2 stands but via 'top-level list is inert — remove entries' rather than 'list is ignored nondeterministically'. No fabrication found; wording is wider than evidence on C2 counts and C3 mechanism, hence FIX not SAFE, and nothing invalidates the audit's core, hence not ABORT.
corrections: Headline scope: '12 live double-surfaces / 352 duplicated tool definitions' is a single-session measurement — re-check session shows 11 live doubles (~330 duplicated definitions; github_cli suppressed). Reword to '10-12 per session, session-variable; 330-353 duplicated definitions observed' and keep the per-server table as one session's snapshot.

Disable-mechanism diagnosis inverted: top-level disabledMcpServers is INERT for names de-listed per-project; the operative scope is per-project disabledMcpServers (120 names at C:/Users/Prekzursil). The '6 disabled-but-live' set reduces to 5 names that are NOT disabled at project scope (angr, claude-code-mcp, paper-search, schrodinger, searxng — live by configuration, not flakiness) plus github_cli which IS disabled at both scopes and did not spawn in the re-check session.

Reclassify nuclei: direct mount exists and is NOT disabled at either scope; its session absence is spawn-side (UNVERIFIED cause — settle via McpHub serve.err.log grep for 'nuclei' or mcp doctor). Remove it from the 'suppressed via disabledMcpServers' cohort.
Re-derive the '45 latent doubles' count against the per-project disabled lists (11-name divergence between scopes at the home project) before citing 45 as config truth.

Process claim split: same-minute launcher pairs (angr pythons 95440+22104 @10:13, 95652+110152 @10:58) prove per-session double-mount spawn; the 4x angr-mcp.exe across 10:13/10:58/11:12/11:36 waves is cross-session orphan accumulation with no reaping. Counts are point-in-time (3->4 instances within hours) — cite with timestamp.
Arithmetic nit: mitmproxy exposes 25 tools per side (24 in D1); duplicated-definition total in D1's session is ~353, not 352.

Confirmed-verbatim config facts safe to cite unchanged: 87 direct mounts incl McpHub(type=http); 65 hub children under settings{} with zero per-child enable flags; overlap 57; hub-only 8 (everything, insta-mcp, fb-messenger, tiktok, markitdown, meta-tool, biomni-hub, sliver); top-level disabled=131 with exactly 50 of 57; registry 92; ~/.mcp.json empty; mtimes 2026-09-19 10:43 / 2026-09-18 22:49 / 22:49.
